'''''Blizzard 2''''' was the codename for an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]].

==History==
[[File:Blizzard2_btm.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The disabled ''Blizzard 2'', shortly before its destruction.]]
A part of the ground assault unit known as [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]], ''Blizzard 2'' was the command vehicle of [[Brigadier]] [[Nevar/Legends|Nevar]].<ref name="Blizzard 2">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Blizzard 2}}</ref> The paranoid general had upgraded the vehicle with additional armor before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. However, during the assault on [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] itself, General Nevar was assassinated aboard ''Blizzard 2''. Although the AT-AT continued to advance, it was subsequently felled by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] in the [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] Rogue Three, and then destroyed when Wedge Antilles circled around to fire at its vulnerable neck.<ref name="SWEIV" />
